crucialFeats: Survives the Source Wall and returns with the Life Equation.
Erases the Source Titans from existence using the Life Equation.
His power nearly destabilizes reality itself.
Unwillingly creates life by his presence.
Changes The Source — the code on which reality is built.

dossier.advantage: Immense versatility and regeneration. White light allows him to heal wounds, recreate matter, and adapt his responses to vastly different threats.
dossier.mentality: Creative, determined, and flexible under pressure. Kyle does not fight by a rigid script — he improvises, adapts quickly, and can escalate his power when the situation demands more than a normal exchange.
dossier.quote: In brightest day, there will be light, To cleanse the soul and set wrongs right. When darkness falls, look to the skies, A new dawn comes, let there be light!
dossier.style: Creative combat with white light constructs. He uses the full spectrum to create an exceptionally wide range of offensive and defensive solutions.

fighterA.name: White Lantern Kyle Rayner

powers: White Lantern spectrum access, construct creation, healing, life-force manipulation, and teleportation.
tools: Life Equation and the ring's versatility in offense, defense, healing, and restoration.
weaknesses: Ring dependence and concentration dependence for top-end effects.
The strongest outcomes, especially with the Life Equation, still require the right window and full control.

crucialFeats: Experiences all time lines at once.
Restructures DC Multiverse (New 52), then fully restores it in a single act of will (Doomsday Clock).

dossier.advantage: Sees all timelines at once and the future of the fight before it begins.
dossier.mentality: A detached observer with a cold, fatalistic outlook. Manhattan does not react like an ordinary human, because he sees events as part of an already existing chain of cause and effect.
dossier.quote: Yes. I see now. Everything ends.
dossier.style: Total control over matter and atoms. He does not fight in a traditional way — he disintegrates targets, rearranges their structure, or removes them from the flow of the fight through a single act of will.

fighterB.name: Dr. Manhattan

powers: Atomic manipulation, matter disintegration/reconstruction, self-reassembly, and simultaneous time perception.
tools: Space-time intervention and causal interference instead of a regular fight.
weaknesses: Tachyon particles can disrupt his perception of time, reducing him to a limited 'here and now' view.
Emotional detachment and fatalism can delay the moment when he chooses to act decisively.

battle-dynamics.label: Life Equation: Full
battle-dynamics.phase_1: With full Life Equation, Kyle becomes a stable point in the continuum that Manhattan cannot instantly disperse.
battle-dynamics.phase_2: The clash turns conceptual. White Light overwrites Manhattan's attempts to alter causality, rewriting the local code of reality.
battle-dynamics.phase_3: Critical point. Kyle imposes the will to exist on every atom, forcing Manhattan to retreat or adapt.
battle-dynamics.analysis: Full Life Equation is the only version of this fight that becomes an even duel of wills.
battle-dynamics.s2_phase_1: Without full Life Equation activation, Kyle remains a massively powerful White Lantern, but he does not yet reach the level of reality control needed to truly take the fight away from Manhattan.
battle-dynamics.s2_phase_2: Kyle tries to fight through constructs, but Manhattan erases the matter they are built from before they can land.
battle-dynamics.s2_phase_3: End of causality. Manhattan removes the very fact of Kyle's existence from the current timeline. No real resistance.
battle-dynamics.s2_analysis: With limited Life Equation, Manhattan controls the clash with mathematical certainty.

fight-simulation.label: Life Equation: Full
fight-simulation.opening: Kyle opens the fight with a White Light salvo, attempting to anchor his presence in time.
fight-simulation.mid_fight: Manhattan attempts to deconstruct the ring at the atomic level, but the Life Equation continually rebuilds and stabilizes its structure.
fight-simulation.late_fight: Kyle imposes the Life Equation onto local space, forcing Manhattan to retreat into other dimensions.
fight-simulation.end_condition: Kyle wins by overwriting local reality through full Life Equation.
fight-simulation.phase_1_event: Kyle uses the Life Equation to create a zone resistant to atomic manipulation.
fight-simulation.phase_2_event: White Light clashes with Manhattan's energy projection at the epicenter of reality.
fight-simulation.phase_2_branch_a: Kyle stabilizes the battlefield and takes the initiative.
fight-simulation.phase_2_branch_b: Manhattan finds a weak point in the stabilization of the Life Equation.
fight-simulation.phase_3_event: Kyle unleashes the full power of the Life Equation, overwriting Manhattan's presence in this timeline.
fight-simulation.phase_3_branch_a: Manhattan is forced out of the current dimension.
fight-simulation.phase_3_branch_b: The local timeline is rewritten into a state where Manhattan's advantage no longer functions.
fight-simulation.s2_phase_1_event: Manhattan appears at several moments in time simultaneously, disorienting Kyle.
fight-simulation.s2_phase_2_event: The battlefield begins to crumble under Manhattan's mere presence.
fight-simulation.s2_phase_2_branch_a: Kyle struggles to maintain his armor.
fight-simulation.s2_phase_2_branch_b: The ring loses stability under Manhattan's direct interference with its structure.
fight-simulation.s2_phase_3_event: Manhattan strikes the moment Kyle Rayner received his first ring.
fight-simulation.s2_phase_3_branch_a: Kyle Rayner is removed from the continuum.
fight-simulation.s2_phase_3_branch_b: Kyle saves himself by retreating into the Source Wall, conceding control of the clash to Manhattan.
fight-simulation.s2_end_condition: Manhattan's victory by removing the opponent from history.

final-summary.line_1: Kyle Rayner has the higher ceiling with full Life Equation, but Manhattan sees future and present at once, so he can preempt the very entry into that state.
final-summary.line_2: Most scenarios favor Manhattan because if he closes the activation window, he wins before Kyle's edge in a normal exchange ever starts to matter.
final-summary.line_3: This is not a fight about greater raw power, but about whether life-will stabilizes before preemption shuts the whole sequence down.
final-summary.winner: Kyle has better stats. Manhattan still leads in most scenarios because he usually does not allow the fight to reach the point where Kyle can use that advantage.

tactical-board.lane: Kyle must force an action window before Manhattan erases the very cause of his existence.
tactical-board.subtitle: Willpower versus Causality

verdict-matrix.subtitle: Conditional result: full Life Equation activation vs Manhattan preemption
verdict-matrix.row_1: FULL LIFE EQUATION ACTIVATION IN TIME
verdict-matrix.case_1: Kyle Rayner 4/10. If Kyle activates the full Life Equation quickly and maintains stable control over it, he can reach a level where his advantage starts to genuinely outscale Manhattan's preemption.
verdict-matrix.case_2: Dr. Manhattan 6/10. If Kyle fails to secure full and stable activation in time, Manhattan more often takes the initiative and closes the fight through preemption.

x-factor.mechanika: Kyle has the Life Equation, but his real edge depends on how stably he can control it.
x-factor.implikacja: Manhattan's preemption is always on: he sees timelines at once and can act before Kyle reaches full activation.
x-factor.psychologia: If Kyle fails to stabilize the Life Equation in time, his higher ceiling never gets to shape the fight.
